by [崔融](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B4%94%E8%9E%8D) (Cuī Róng, 653–706)

Preserved as **DZ 971** / CT 971 (*Dòngshén bù, Jì chuán lèi* 洞神部記傳類). (Note: there is no DZ 970 in the canonical sequence as received; CT numbering proceeds 969 → 971.)
